info.title: Waqar Akhtar — Portfolio API
info.description: Read-only, programmatic access to Waqar Akhtar's portfolio website (https://waqarakhtar.codes). All endpoints are public, require no authentication, and are served as static files. Content covers bio, skills, professional experience, education, projects, hackathon achievements, resume (PDF), and a plain-language AI site overview (llms.txt). An MCP tool manifest is also available at /.well-known/mcp.json.

get.description: Plain-language description of Waqar Akhtar and the site, with a structured index of every key page, project, achievement, and contact channel. Best starting point for agents.

Hero introduction, about summary, skills badges, experience timeline, programs, featured work, education, resume link, and contact section. Key content anchors: #about, #skills, #experience, #programs, #projects, #education, #contact.
Full, categorized list of all projects with descriptions, tech stacks, and links to live demos and source code.
Download Waqar Akhtar's resume as a PDF document.
MCP discovery manifest describing read-only tools agents can use (URL-based GET tools for overview, home, projects, individual project lookup, resume, and contact info).
Returns this OpenAPI 3.1 document describing programmatic access to the site.
